On September 24, 1937 a Russian named Alexey Alexandrovich
SENKO, aged 39, a musician employed with Nick Korin's Orchestra,
engaged with the Wing On Company's Ball Room, Nanking Road, was
arrested by the Chinese Authorities in Nantao for alleged
espionage activities. He was detained until October 8 when he
was released from custody.
Interviewed by the undersigned, Senko related the following
details regarding the circumstances of his arrest:-
At about 11 am. on September 24, whilst under the influence
of alcohol, he took a ricsha at the corner of Route Pere Robert
and Route Vallon in order to proceed to an acquaintance residing
at the south end of Route Pere Robert.
While on the way he fell asleep and in this state was taken
by the ricsha coolie across the Zikawei Creek into Chinese
territory, where he was arrested by a group of Chinese soldiers,
who took him to a military office near the Zikawei Creek,
whence he was subsequently escorted in a motor car to the
Shanghai City Government Police Bureau, Nantao. On October 1
he was transferred to the Military Court Prison.
During his interrogation at the Shanghai City Government
Police Bureau and the Military Court, Senko was asked if he worked
as a spy for the Japanese, if he had any friends who were in
the employ of the Japanese and whether he sympathised with
China or Japan.
It appears that suspicions against Senko were aroused by
the fact that there were initials (A.S.) and a Chinese laundry
mark (91) on a handkerchief found in his possession. Following
his interrogation by the Military Court Senko was allowed to

1937年9月24日，一名名为 Alexey Alexandrovich SENKO（阿列克谢·亚历山德罗维奇·先科）的俄罗斯人，现年39岁，系受雇于南京路永安公司舞厅 Nick Korin 乐队的乐师，在南市被中国当局以涉嫌从事间谍活动为由逮捕。他被拘留至10月8日获释。
经下文签署人讯问，Senko 就其被捕情形陈述了以下细节：
9月24日上午11时许，他在酒精影响下，于贝当路（Route Pere Robert）与华伦路（Route Vallon）转角处雇了一辆人力车，欲前往居住在贝当路南端的一位熟人家中。
途中他睡着了，在此状态下被人力车夫拉过肇嘉浜（Zikawei Creek）进入中国地界，随即被一群中国士兵逮捕，并将他带至肇嘉浜附近的一处军事办事处，随后由汽车押送至位于南市的上海市政府警察局。10月1日，他被移解至军事法庭监狱。
在上海市政府警察局及军事法庭受审期间，当局询问 Senko 是否担任日本间谍，是否有朋友受雇于日本人，以及他是同情中国还是日本。

Ta Mei Wan Pao published the following article on October 12 :-

ENEMY ESPIONAGE BEHIND THE CHINESE LINES

Undesirable elements, traitors and foreign spies must be first wiped out if it is desired to consolidate the rear of the Chinese forces.
It is known to all that the organization of the net of spies of Japan in China is very vigilant. The enemy is able to understand in a short time Chinese political, military and economic arrangements. This is entirely due to the meritorious service rendered by a crowd of "hunting dogs". In addition to Japanese ronins, the enemy is always pleased to bribe foreign spies, such as Koreans, Formosans, Portuguese, White Russians and disappointed Chinese military men and politicians. These spies receive wages every month on condition that they are able to supply information from time to time.
In order to attain its object of securing information from the Chinese Government, the Japanese Government does not hesitate to spend huge sums of money to form secretly in various parts of China the so-called "special service organ" (the Japanese organization of espionage). However, the Chinese Government is well prepared to deal with the situation and has instructed the district authorities to adopt strict precautions against all spies.
What is worthy for us to note at the present time is the movements of innumerable White Russians in China. Prior to local hostilities, these White Russians had already used Hongkew and Chapei as their headquarters for the "special service organ". Now, they are active in both the French Concession and the International Settlement.
The chief reasons why the Japanese regard White Russians as able to carry out important espionage are :-
1) It is easy for White Russians to escape attention from the Chinese authorities.
2) White Russians are well acquainted with the conditions in China for they have been wandering in China for a long time.
3) White Russians can undertake hard work and are not afraid of sacrifices.
Some White Russians have military experience and ample knowledge. White Russians in ragged clothing can be seen occasionally on the streets and alleyways. We must realize that most of them are faithful running dogs of our enemy. This point must not be neglected.

中国防线后方的敌方间谍活动

若要巩固中国军队的后方，必须首先清除不良分子、汉奸和外国间谍。
众所周知，日本在华的间谍网组织非常严密。敌人之所以能在短时间内掌握中国的政治、军事和经济部署，完全归功于一群“猎犬”的效劳。除了日本浪人之外，敌人还乐于收买外国间谍，如朝鲜人、台湾人、葡萄牙人、白俄以及失意的中国军人和政治家。这些间谍只要能够不时提供情报，便可按月领取薪水。
为了达到从中国政府获取情报的目的，日本政府不惜花费巨资，在中国各地秘密组建所谓的“特务机关”（即日本的间谍组织）。然而，中国政府已做好充分准备以应对这一局势，并指示地方当局对所有间谍采取严格的防范措施。

1) 白俄容易避开中国当局的注意。

事由 I. E. Zigalnitsky 在南京因涉嫌从事间谍活动被捕。
呈报人 D. S. Tcheremshansky 转呈人 C Crawford & J

从可靠消息来源获悉，犹太裔俄国人 Isay Evseyevich Zigalnitsky，1879年生于西伯利亚外贝加尔省上乌丁斯克 (Verhneudinsk)，职业为商人，系南京“Astro”餐厅、糖果店及面包房的所有者，于1937年8月29日在该市因涉嫌为日本从事间谍活动而被捕。据报道，得知其被捕后，他在上海的兄弟和朋友聘请了当地法国律师 Auxion de Ruffe 先生，后者随后通过法国大使的斡旋，成功使 Zigalnitsky 于9月17日或18日左右获释。Zigalnitsky 的妻子 Maria Kazimirovna Zigalnitsky 夫人，1887年生于瑞士，在其丈夫被捕四天后也被捕，并于同日获释。Zigalnitsky 获释后，被允许继续经营其业务，但不准离开南京。
值得注意的是，Zigalnitsky 的兄弟 L.E. Zigalnitsky 先生（别名 Zigal），美国联邦三角形汽车公司 (Triangle Motors, Fed. Inc. U.S.A.) 总经理兼合伙人，办公地址位于嘉尔登路99号，在其兄弟被捕后不久便前往日本，据信是为了避免被中国当局逮捕的可能性。对三角形汽车公司的查询显示，Zigal 先生原计划在日本停留5或6个月，预计将于数日内返回上海。

REPORTS FROM RUSSIAN CIRCLES OF SHANGHAI REGARD
TOWN DEPLORE USE OF RUSSIAN UNDERWORLD BY JA-
PANESE.

Shanghai,18th Sept. -

Local Russian emigrants circles are concerned
by the arrest of three Russians in Nantao on suspicion of being
engaged in espionage activities on behalf of the Japanese. It
is admitted that in Tientsin and even in Shanghai the Japanese
have enlisted members of the White Russian underworld to enter
the Chinese lines on one pretext or another for the purpose of
obtaining information of a military nature. The activities of
such people became prevalent in Pootung. As a consequence,in
certain areas Russians are immediately held for questioning by
the authorities.

" As we earn our livelihood in China and we have
chosen that our future be bound up with the Chinese People,any
of our countrymen who work for the Japanese are just as much
traitors as if they were Chinese. The Japanese probably make
use of beggars,drug takers,and generally members of the under
world of the Russian colony",declared one influential Russian
merchant of Avenue Joffre. " But as a whole we are whole-hearted-
ly on China's side in her gallant and victorious fight against
Japanese aggression. And we shall in every way try to assist
the authorities to weed out the rascals who are bringing disre-
pute to the Emigrant Russian Colony of Shanghai".

上海俄国圈子报告
痛惜日本人利用俄国黑社会分子。

上海，9月18日 -

上海本地俄国侨民圈子对三名俄国人因疑似为日本从事间谍活动而在南市被捕一事表示关切。人们承认，在天津甚至在上海，日本人都征募白俄黑社会成员，以各种借口潜入中国防线，目的是获取军事情报。此类人员的活动在浦东尤为盛行。因此，在某些地区，俄国人会立即被当局扣留盘问。

“我们在中国谋生，并选择将我们的未来与中国人民联系在一起，任何为我们敌人日本人工作的同胞，都与中国人中的汉奸无异。日本人可能利用乞丐、吸毒者以及俄国侨民群体中的一般黑社会分子”，一位霞飞路有影响力的俄国商人宣称。“但总体而言，我们全心全意支持中国英勇抗击日本侵略的战斗。我们将尽一切努力协助当局清除那些给上海俄国侨民群体带来耻辱的败类”。
